rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı renders the verse as denying prophets any right to demand worship, while their proper task is to raise rabbānīs through teaching and study.
rows.anchor: Allah’tan beride bana kul olun” diyebilsin. Velâkin “kitab tâlim etmekte olduğunuz ve ders alıp vermekte bulunduğunuz için rabbânîler olunuz”

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God took a mutually affirming covenant from all prophets when granting scripture and wisdom, under divine testimony.
rows.anchor: Allah bütün peygamberlerine kitab ve hikmet verirken hepsinin böyle bir ahd ü mîsâkını almıştır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All prophets pledged to God that they would believe in and support Muhammad, who confirms them.
rows.anchor: Muhammed Resûlullah’a iman ve nusret için Hak teâlâ’ya ikrar vermişlerdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rendering calls the many ribbiyyūn rubūbiyya-aware devotees and says they did not flag, weaken, or abase themselves after hardship in God's path.
rows.anchor: Nice peygamber maiyyetinde rubûbiyet-âşinâ birçok erenler harb ettiler de Allah yolunda başlarına gelenlerden dolayı fütur getirmediler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ribbiyyūn is the plural of ribbī, related to Rabb like rabbānī, and means people who serve the Lord; the rā's kasra follows nisba morphology.
rows.anchor: Ribbiyyûn” رِ ِّبي’nin cem‘idir ki “rabbânî” gibi, “rabb”e nisbettir. Rabbe kulluk eden demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another analysis relates ribbī to ribbe, meaning a group, and interprets the plural as a community through its collective sense.
rows.anchor: esasında ictimâ‘î mefhûmu mülâhazasıyla “cemaat” diye tefsir edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: Vâhidî; Ferrâ
rows.claim: As transmitted by al-Wāḥidī from al-Farrāʾ, ribbiyyūn can mean al-awwalūn, the earlier people.
rows.anchor: Vâhidî’nin Ferrâ’dan nakli vechile رِبِّيُّونَ evvelûn, yani evvelkiler mânasına da gelir.

rows.speaker: İbn Zeyd
rows.claim: Ibn Zayd distinguishes rabbānīs as imam-governors and ribbīs as their subjects.
rows.anchor: İbn Zeyd demiştir ki “rabbânî” e’imme-i vülât, “ribbî” de ra‘iyyedir ki “ribb”e müntesibdirler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı prefers reading ribbiyyūn as a community trained and educated under the Lord, while rabbānīs are advanced enough to teach and train others.
rows.anchor: رِبِّيُّونَ “ribb”e intisap ile terbiye ve tâlim görmüş cemaat, “rabbânî” de “rabb”e intisap ile diğerlerini tâlim ve terbiye edebilecek seviyye-i âliyede bulunanlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He allows ribbiyyūn and rabbāniyyūn to be synonymous, or ribbiyyūn to be the broader term.
rows.anchor: bunların müterâdif veya “ribbiyyûn”, “rabbâniyyûn”dan e‘am olarak da kullanılması câiz olur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The role of prophets is to raise rabbānīs through teaching and study; cultivating them is one major wisdom of Muhammad's mission, and 3:110 announces his community as the best nation.
rows.anchor: büyük hikmetlerinden birisi de rabbâniyyûn yetiştirmek olduğu anlaşılmış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the Uhud context, the verse gently rebukes Muhammad's companions: as candidates to become the best community and rabbānīs, they should match earlier prophets' followers instead of collapsing at the rumor of the Prophet's death.
rows.anchor: Uhud” hâdisesi dolayısıyla ashâb-ı Muhammedî yüksek bir mazmun ile terbiye edilmek üzere, siz böyle hayr-ı ümem olacak rabbânîler olmaya namzed iken enbiyâ-yı sâlifenin ümmetleri kadar da olamayacak mısınız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Trials in property and life include destructive losses, death, wounds, captivity, hardship, distress, and fear.
rows.anchor: Emvâlinizde itlâfa müeddî bazı âfetler ve nefislerinizde maktûliyet, mecrûhiyet veya esaret veya diğer bazı zahmetler, meşakkatler, korkular vesâire gibi mukadderât ile mübtelâ kılınacaksınız.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because God does not acquire knowledge by experimentation, trial language is metaphorical for administering a test; it teaches servants the importance of experiential knowledge and making experience a basis for action.
rows.anchor: Allah teâlâ’nın tecribe ile ilim istihsâlinden münezzeh ve müstağnî bulunduğu mâlum olduğu cihetle bu gibi âyetlerde بـَلْوَى ve اِبْتِلاَء imtihan muamelesi yapmak mânasına bir istiaredir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı lists the Finhas incident as one of three reported occasions for the verse's revelation.
rows.anchor: Bu âyetin de, لَّقَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ’da zikr olunduğu üzere Finhas vak‘ası

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second reported occasion is Kaʿb ibn al-Ashraf's poetry inciting polytheists against the Messenger.
rows.anchor: şiirleriyle müşrikleri Resûl-i Ekrem aleyhine teşvik ve tehyic eden Ka‘b b. Eşref

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A third reported occasion is ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ubayy's insolent remark at a gathering where the Prophet recited Qur'an.
rows.anchor: Resûlullah’ın teşrif buyurup Kur’an okuduğu bir mecliste إِنْ كَانَ حَقًّا فَلاَ تـُؤْذِنَا بِهِ فيِ مجََالِسِنَا diye küstahlık eden Abdullah b. Übey

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience and taqwā mean turning away from offenders and seeking God's protection wholeheartedly; these are honorable, virtuous, important matters requiring resolve and the means to succeed in trials.
rows.anchor: işte bu sabr u ittikā işi ‘azâim-i umûrdandır. Yani azmedilmesi lâzım gelen şerefli, meziyetli, mühim işlerdendir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those given scripture are Jewish and Christian scholars; the pronoun can refer to the scripture or, more specifically, the Prophet whose truthfulness it establishes, and they were bound to explain both the scripture's truths and his prophethood.
rows.anchor: Bu kitab verilmiş olanlardan murad ehl-i kitab olan Yehûd ve Nasârâ ulemâsıdır. Bunların işbu أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ unvânıyla yâd edilmeleri

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some exegetes include Muslims among those given scripture, but Elmalılı says this inclusion is by implication, not by the wording itself.
rows.anchor: Fakat bunun bi’l-ibâre olmayıp bi’d-delâle olacağı unutulmamak lâzım gelir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Having received a book, being its people and literate, entails undertaking to publish and explain it; all revealed books command this with proofs.
rows.anchor: bir kitaba nâil olmuş bulunmak, ehl-i kitab ve okur yazar olmak, o kitâbın neşr ü beyânını taahhüd etmektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah and Gospel announce the attributes and truthfulness of the Seal of the Prophets; believing in him belongs to belief in those scriptures, and announcing him was the greatest glad tidings their people awaited.
rows.anchor: Tevrat ve İncil’in münderecâtı meyânında “O Peygamber”in, yani Hâtemü’l-Enbiyâ hazretleri’nin evsâfı ve sıdk-ı nübüvveti tebşir ve beyan edilmiş ve buna iman o kitablara iman cümlesinden olmuştur.

rows.speaker: Said b. Cübeyr; Süddî
rows.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and al-Suddī take the pronoun in the covenant verse to refer to Muhammad.
rows.anchor: Said b. Cübeyr ve Süddî rivayetlerinde zamir “Muhammed”e

rows.speaker: Hasan; Katâde
rows.claim: Al-Hasan and Qatāda take the pronoun in the covenant verse to refer to the scripture.
rows.anchor: Hasan ve Katâde rivayetlerinde “kitab”a ircâ‘edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the general reading, Elmalılı calls the pronoun an allusive reference to the truth the scripture must disclose.
rows.anchor: zamiri kinaye, husûsî nokta-i nazara göre de

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scriptural scholars broke their pledge, concealed truth, and caused harm to the Prophet and Muslims; Jews did so first and Christians later followed.
rows.anchor: hakkı ketm ettiler de Peygamber’e ve Müslümanlara ezâ ve iz‘âca kalkıştılar.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase little price compares finite worldly gain, however large, with eternal afterlife reward; it also hints that they debased scripture even for a few coins or minor benefit.
rows.anchor: Semen haddizâtında ne kadar çok olursa olsun mütenâhî ve fâni olduğu için ebedî ve nâmütenâhî olan ecr-i uhrevîye nazaran pek az bir şey olduğundan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says Muslims too have fallen into this corruption: ignorant people pressure scholars for agreeable answers, while scholar-imitators seek vile benefits and treat religious learning as a deception trap.
rows.anchor: Ulemâdan hakkı aramayıp gönlüne göre yanlış bir cevâb-ı muvâfakat almak için teşvik veya tehdit eden birçok câhil, ahlâksız Müslümanlar bulunduğu gibi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God warns Muslims to fulfill their pledge with steadfastness and sincerity, state and spread truth in word and deed, and exalt God's word, while condemning the People of the Book's conduct.
rows.anchor: Müslümanları bilhassa bu hâllerden tahzir edip sabr u ittikā, sebât ü azm ile îfâ-yı taahhüde; sadâkat ü ciddiyet

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although revealed in connection with hypocrites, the warning applies generally to arrogant people among disbelievers, polytheists, and Muslims.
rows.anchor: Bu âyet münafıklar dolayısıyla nâzil olmuş bulunmakla beraber hükmü gerek sâir küffâr ve müşrikînden ve gerek Müslümanlardan bu ahlâkta bulunan ashâb-ı gurûrun hepsine şâmildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The condemned person is proud of deeds, inattentive to the future, and forgets that acceptance and commendation of duty are not theirs to claim; enjoying praise for undone work is pleasure in distorting truth and forgetting God.
rows.anchor: Mağrurlanmak, istikbalden gaflet etmek ve vazifenin kabul ve tahsîni kendine ait olmadığını bilmemek, yaptığı işi büyüksünüp kendine onu büyük görmek gibi bir küçüklüktür.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pride leads to enjoying praise for deeds one did not do; together these traits make a person deserving of painful punishment.
rows.anchor: Evvelkisi buna sevk eder. Bu ikisi bir yere gelince de azâb-ı elîme müstahik olur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage teaches Muslims perfect servitude and high morals, drawing spirits from people to God and hearts from worldly delusion toward the forgiving King while summarizing the grounds of the preceding exhortations.
rows.anchor: Cenâb-ı Allah Müslümanlara bütün muvaffakiyeti temin edecek olan kemâl-i ubûdiyet ile me‘âlî-i

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening warning is rendered as asking people to fear disobeying their Lord and to seek refuge in his nurturing and protection; the verse also has them appeal to God and kinship ties.
rows.anchor: Sakının o Rabbinize karşı gelmekten ki sizleri bir tek nefisten yarattı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı describes the surah as covering divine rights and universal human brotherhood, care and rights of children, women and orphans, property, marriage, inheritance, and duties including purification, prayer, jihad, and obedience to authority; these rest on human nature and nurture.
rows.anchor: Evvelinde hukūk-ı rabbâniye, uhuvvet-i âmme-i insâniye; evlâda, kadınlara, yetimlere re’fet ve şefkat ve hukuklarının edası, mallarının muhafazası, nikâh ve miras gibi husûsâta müte‘allik evâmir ve ahkâm ile başlamış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening general address recalls al-Baqara's first general address, which commanded worship and argued from human creation, especially Adam; here taqwā is followed by the creation of woman, signaling that women's issues are a major duty.
rows.anchor: O hitâb-ı âm ittikā gayesiyle اُعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ emrini vermiş ve bunu hilkat-i beşeriye delilleriyle tenvir ederek hâlden mebde’e doğru götürmüş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only al-Nisāʾ and al-Ḥajj begin with the address to all people; their openings, each fourth in its half of the Qur'an, ground law respectively in creation's beginning and its end and the afterlife, showing the bases for their legal rulings.
rows.anchor: Kur’an’da يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ matla‘ıyla başlayan iki sûre vardır. Birisi bu, diğeri Sûre-i Hac’dır.

rows.speaker: Fahreddîn Râzî
rows.claim: Al-Rāzī says that many subtle secrets lie beneath this discussion.
rows.anchor: Fahreddîn Râzî der ki: “Bu bahsin altında esrâr-ı kesîre vardır.”

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To fear one's Lord is to enter under his nurturing and protection, submit generally to his command, avoid disobedience, and fear his punishment.
rows.anchor: Rabbinizin hükm-i terbiye ve vikāyesine giriniz, emrine muhalefetten sakınıp umûmiyetle inzıbâta tâbi‘olunuz, ikābından korununuz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation from one soul means all people descend from one father, share humanity, and are creatures of one Maker; rights should rest on humanity and nurture, with mutual brotherhood observed.
rows.anchor: Binâen‘aleyh ‘an-asl hepiniz bir babadan gelme kardeşlersiniz ve hepiniz insansınız ve bir hâlıkın mahluklarısınız.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creating the spouse from the one soul was a bestowed gift and made a pair in which one comes from the other's life; 36:36 likewise says God created pairs.
rows.anchor: Biri diğerinin canından kopmuş bir çift meydana getirdi سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The diversity of male and female offspring refutes nature as an autonomous fixed cause: neither sex simply repeats the other, while both are distinct complementary forms from one origin.
rows.anchor: ne topraktan insan zuhur edebilirdi ne de bir erkekten bir dişi evlâd olabilirdi. Çünkü tabiat ıttırad demek değil ise hiçbir şey değildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even natural scientists acknowledge that pure nature cannot explain this diversity; a Lord above nature produces nurturing effects through creation and selection, so nature alone is no scientific first principle.
rows.anchor: tabî‘at-ı mahza davası içinde bu tenevvü‘kābil-i îzah değildir. Ve kudret-i hâlıka tabiatın fevkinde terbiyevî bir tesir icrâ eden ve âsârını halk u ıstıfâ ile meydana getiren bir Rabb-i a‘lâdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblīs was misled by reasoning from a supposed fiery nature when he claimed superiority over Adam, who was made from clay.
rows.anchor: diye tabî‘at-ı nâriyeye binâ ettiği kıyasla aldanmıştır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At humanity's origin the evidence is clearest: the mind must locate the first cause beyond humans and material nature, in the Creator who made the spouse from one soul and then spread many men and women.
rows.anchor: ne de tabî‘at-ı eşyâda görmemeli, hepsinin fevkinde Hâlık teâlâ’da görmelidir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity's expansion from a single pair demonstrates God's lordship and ability to raise nations from one person; believers should fulfill duties, sacrifice for God's way, honor marriage, have children, nurture them, and avoid misusing sexual inclinations.
rows.anchor: Binâen‘aleyh hiç yokken topraktan ıstıfâ ile insan yaratan ve o insandan eşini yaratan ve iki insandan bi’ttevâlüd erkek dişi birçok evlâd ve ahfâd yaratıp dünyaya yayan Hâlık teâlâ’nın rubûbiyeti

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet urged marriage and procreation, saying he would boast of his community before other nations on Resurrection Day, even through a miscarried child.
rows.anchor: Resûlullah تـَنَاكَحُوا تـَنَاسَلُوا فَإِ ِّني أُبَاهِي بِكُمُ الأُْمَمَ يـَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَوْ بِال َّسقْطِ buyurmuştur.
